_note._: This key is not an instrument class. Keys beginning with _ are notes.
_note.every_class_needs_an_entry: Every INSTRUMENT:<Class> directory here is an instrument class and must appear here under its BARE name (the key is `DMM`, the folder is `INSTRUMENT:DMM`; the prefix is the directory's only, never the type, topic, tab or port lane). Its GUI files live in `INSTRUMENT:<Class>/gui/` — `<Class>.json`, `<Class>_N.json`, `<Class>.cad.json`, `<Class>.probe.json`, `<Class>.dxf` — and its models beside `gui/`. Counter, DAQ, SMU and VNA had a symlink and no entry until 2026-08-30, so they existed to `ls` and not to this file, and nothing reported the gap. `check.sh binding` now fails when they diverge.
_note.the_short_form_is_deliberate: A class may carry `tab` alone. `groups` declares a PRE-BUILT panel — a named bank over several devices, with a station and an id — and only four classes have one because only four have a bank worth pre-declaring. The short form means 'this class renders its devices individually', not 'this entry is unfinished'.
_note.tab_is_an_ordering_prefix: The digit before the underscore orders the tabs and, since the instrument APIs were given addresses, ALSO FIXES THE CLASS'S PORT LANE: _komand/generate_device_apis.py reads it as family_index and every model in the class lands on 15000 + family_index * 100 + its position in the sorted model list. It used to be free to renumber; it is not any more, because renumbering a tab moves 100 ports. 6 was free and the three above 9 are new.
